lawnicons.description:
Monochrome outlined brand icons for Android launchers.
Lawnicons is an icon pack developed by the Lawnchair team and supported by the community. Originally an addon for Lawnchair 12 Alpha 5 and above to implement themed icons, it can now be used on many launchers.

Try Lawnicons on the latest version of Lawnchair. You can enable themed icons by going to Home Settings → General → Icon Style and choosing the desired option.
